name: invented5
idea: The target stack (bingo+sms+stride) only models spatial patterns within a page and 1-step strides, failing to capture the >8-line jumps that constitute the majority of this workload's predictable strides (63–68% of stride-repeats). A high-degree stride prefetcher catches these long strides that the target misses, and by keying on the line index within a 4KB page (`(addr >> 6) & 0x3F`) it remains v
